  Why it fails at runtime: Real CI/sandbox runners hit PermissionError, producing 5 failing tests and breaking the focused detector-test contract.

  Line or code reference: regex `(?P=quote)(?:\s+.*)?$`
  Problem: The heredoc matcher can miss `python3 - <<'PY' | ...` and similar lines with trailing shell content after the closing quote.
  Why it fails at runtime: Heredoc bodies in real shell scripts can be skipped, which means the slop-scan misses actual findings.
